title: An alert storm starved the API and every sign-in returned busy
problem: The alert webhook scanned the whole notifications table once per alert, so a burst of device-offline alerts took every database connection and sign-in failed with 503 for hours.
fix: Repeats are dropped in Redis, device alerts are grouped per source, delivery runs in the background on its own small pool, sign-in has its own pool, and old alert notices are capped and pruned.

title: One busy answer from the API signed the user out
problem: A single 503 while checking who is signed in was treated as signed out, so people were sent to the landing page in the middle of their work.
fix: The web retries busy answers with backoff, refreshes a stale session, shows Reconnecting and signs out only when the server refuses the session.

title: Pages showed false states when the API was busy
problem: A failed load showed a streaming asset as offline and never seen, an admin as view only, or a skeleton that never ended.
fix: Pages say they could not load and retry, and permissions that fail to load are never read as Member.

title: Capture a live message could wait for ever
problem: Capturing a sample from a source that was off or failing sign-in sat on Waiting with no way out.
fix: Capture shows a countdown with Cancel and gives up after 20 seconds with the reason and Retry.

title: Send a test message only worked right after a token was made
problem: Reopening a push source disabled the test button, and the only way to test was to rotate the token and break real senders.
fix: The test message is sent by the server, any time, and says where it landed or why the mapping missed it.

title: The first push test message failed with the default mapping
problem: The guide's push mapping and its sample snippet disagreed, so the first message went to Problems.
fix: The snippet sends the guide's own sample, so the first test lands as an asset.

title: The testbed's sign-in details were nowhere in the UI
problem: Adding a Kafka source against the testbed needed a password shown nowhere, and the testbed card vanished once any source existed.
fix: Add a source offers Use the testbed's details at any time, for admins.

title: Chat did not say a command was waiting for approval
problem: While a machine command waited on Approvals the chat only said it was checking the reply, and a denied command read as failed.
fix: The command tool's status now survives the agent's tool settings, so chat shows Waiting for approval with a link and then Denied with the reason.

title: Push devices took 15 minutes to go offline
problem: A device heard only a few times had no learnt pace and fell back to the 15 minute cap, which looked like never.
fix: A device heard once goes offline after 5 minutes, and a few messages set the pace from the longest gap.

title: Show revoked did nothing on device keys
problem: Ticking Show revoked never showed revoked keys.
fix: The list asks for revoked keys when the box is ticked.

title: Asset cards broke on a phone
problem: At 390 pixels the asset grid kept four columns, hid names and overlapped its labels.
fix: The grid measures its width and shows one card per row on a phone.

title: A rule's alert link opened an unfiltered list of thousands
problem: Opening the alert from a rule firing landed on every alert with no filter, and firing alerts said they resolved just now.
fix: The link opens Alerts filtered to the rule, Alerts can be searched and filtered, and firing alerts have no resolve time.

title: The push snippet reused one idempotency key
problem: Running the copied snippet twice was accepted but the second message was silently dropped as a repeat.
fix: Every snippet makes a fresh key per send.

title: Edge install defaults did not work from the gateway box
problem: The install command pointed at localhost and named a different image than the Edge page.
fix: The address comes from a public address setting or the address the page was reached on, and the image is the same everywhere.
